business_summary: Merit Interactive Co.,Ltd. operates as a professional data intelligent service provider in China. It provides push messaging, overseas push, AI application workshop, one-click authentication, and visual intelligent tools, as well as marketing data panel and population data tools. The company also operates user insight and data analysis platforms, as well as message centers. In addition, it offers data platform solutions; internet growth, brand marketing, urban governance, big data-driven precision publicity, digitalization of banks, intelligent risk control, and science and technology philanthropy solutions; and personalized intelligent workstation AI solutions. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Merit Interactive Network Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Merit Interactive Co.,Ltd. in October 2020. Merit Interactive Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
